TEXT.English:
Many easily switch the gnomes of the Kith with dwarves, and indeed, they certainly share common ancestors. The Kith were a creation during the Age of Magic by Patrian mages in cruel experiments. The idea was to use the robust and clever surface dwarves as workers. The result was the slightly smaller gnomes. They were split into different groups, each receiving their own tasks and specializations.
After Patria fell apart in the Age of Ice, the gnomes stayed in their groups and tried to survive during this harsh age. Each Kith, the name that formed for these groups, developed its own culture and way of handling things. Most Kith fell apart or simply vanished during the blizzards or ran out of resources to sustain themselves. Some ended in civil wars that broke out over the dwindling food and heat sources.
With the Age of Rebirth, two gnomes stepped forward and contacted all Kith in their reach. Woodrow and Amberly united the Kith under their banner, a federal union that was built on cooperation between the Kith without destroying their self-governance and culture. It was the birth of the Eadig Kith, the Blessed Kith Union.

Complexity: Advanced In unity lays our size! [H2]General[\H2] - Your cities have a 1 Tile Radius only. You will need to place them close together and build more cities than with other Civs. - Each City specializes on one Kith. - Your Army is split between normal Units and the Hero and national Units. Normal Units are weaker, while your hero and national units are stronger. [H2]Kith System[\H2] - Each City specializes on one Kith. Build the Kith Buildings for that. - Flodweard Kith: Cities with River Tiles and focus on Food production. - Nettere Kith: Cities on Coasts with strong Water Tile focus. - Tol Kith: Cities with focus on Research, Mutations and Magic. - Delfan Kith: Cities with focus on Mines, Production and Siege Weapons. - Feoh Kith: Cities with Trade focus. - Hild Kith: Cities with Military production focus. [H2]Army[\H2] - Your normal Units are weaker due to the Kith Militia promotion. - Your Heroes and National Unique Units are stronger due to the Kith Ealdor promotion. - Use your normal units as meatshields while protecting your strong elite Units.

The Kith Tribal System is based on the promise of cooperation between the Kith without harming their own cultural values and their self governence. Each Kith specialized and shared their products for the greater good of all Kith.
